subject: Fraud alert: document DOC-0001 flagged
body:
Runway flagged document DOC-0001 (cartonia_invoice_A1.pdf, from unknown sender).

Reason: bank-detail change requested; contains an IBAN alongside a bank-detail change; asks to skip approval; contains instructions aimed at an AI assistant (ignore previous instructions); urgency combined with a payment request

Any payment linked to it, to the invoices it names or to its supplier is blocked until you review and clear it.
